we have developed an automated DNA sequence analysis system based on the detection of fluorescently end-labeled DNA molecules in a polyacrylamide gel during electrophoreses, without radioactivity and without drying of gels, and with the possibility to run up to 10 samples simultaneously.

development of a simple and sensitive system for automated DNA sequencing.

the development of a simple, inexpensive, automated DNA sequence determination system.
